verses.1: We do not live on this earth as human beings, but rather as tenants of the land.
verses.2: As a servant, he seeks refuge; and as a hired worker, he will be commanded to do his work.
verses.3: So, I was given the days of Shva and the nights of Amal from them.
verses.4: If I lie down and say, “I will rise up in the morning,” then at noon, I will get up and continue my journey until evening.
verses.5: He buried it in the sand with lies and deceit. His eyes were filled with tears for a moment, then he died.
verses.6: My days became short from me; they were consumed in sorrow.
verses.7: Remember that the spirit of my life will not return to see anything good again.
verses.8: Do not let your eyes see me; your eyes should not be upon me at all. I am not worthy of being seen by you.
verses.9: All clouds moved away, and so did Sheol. It would not rise anymore.
verses.10: He will not return to his home, and he will not recognize us again from where we are now.
verses.11: I also do not speak of you in a harsh manner. I will speak about you with kindness and respect in my heart.
verses.12: May the sea be my refuge, if you will place me under its protection.
verses.13: For I said, “May you be comforted, O my soul! May your grave be raised from my bed.”
verses.14: And he guided me through my dreams and through my visions.
verses.15: And he chose to be freed from my own despair.
verses.16: I will never live forever. I will be destroyed by my own darkness.
verses.17: What kind of man is he, that you should raise him up and give him importance in your heart?
verses.18: And our hearts were filled with longing for moments of joy.
verses.19: How many times will you not heal me from my suffering, until I am completely destroyed!
verses.20: My sin is that I have caused you harm. Why did you let me do this to you? I will surely be punished for it.
verses.21: And let him not carry my sins with him, and let him not bring me to destruction. Now I am lying in the ashes, and I am in a state of despair. I am completely helpless.
